title: Chapter 1342
text:
Ten minutes later, in a certain space in the deeper layers of the secondary dimension world.

On the boundless white sand sea, a light suddenly flickered, and a figure fell out of thin air. He landed on the sand sea with a plop and staggered.

Han Xiao barely managed to stabilize himself. He took a deep breath and put away the black and gold King mechanical suit on his body, revealing his body that was covered in wounds. Blood sprayed out from the ferocious wounds and seeped into the sand. Very soon, the ground was dyed golden red. There were also large scorch marks on his body, and his cells were necrotic. It was a shocking sight.

"Hu … I almost flipped over. Fighting one against a hundred is indeed too much. Hiss, it hurts."

A burning pain spread throughout his body, as if every cell was wailing. Han Xiao's face trembled slightly. He took out a syringe gun and injected a tube of high-concentration Aurora's life essence into his body. A wave of numbness and comfort swept through his body, suppressing the pain. His body became warm.

A platinum light surged, and the wounds on Han Xiao's body quickly closed, returning to his healthy body. Only blood stains were left.

It was quite dangerous just now. The combined strength of more than a hundred Beyond Grade As exceeded his limit, and there were more than twenty peak Beyond Grade As among them, as well as experts like the Subduing Tree King. He was fighting alone.

They were all Beyond Grade As. Even if his combat strength was off the charts, as long as he did not break through to a new level, he still could not completely ignore the difference in numbers. Just the Subduing Tree King alone was already very difficult to deal with. He was the strongest Pugilist he had fought so far, not to mention that he had a bunch of experts helping him.

There was no need to elaborate on the process. There was no way he had the upper hand, and it was also wishful thinking to hope for a draw. The combined damage of so many experts had already exceeded his recovery speed. His health bar rose and fell like a roller coaster, and at the most dangerous moment, his health bar even fell below 16%. If it were any other Beyond Grade As in the explored universe, they would probably be dead by now. Wuornos, who had the Ethereal National Treasure, would most likely not be able to withstand it.

However, Han Xiao did not intend to fight to the death. He hid many abilities mainly to achieve his goal and obtain the battle information of the Subduing Tree King.

Although the other party's level was higher, causing some of his attributes to be questioned, many of his abilities were also exposed. The value of this information was not small. If he met the Subduing Tree King again in the future, he would know what to do.

After receiving the information from the Subduing Tree King, Han Xiao did not dare to continue fighting. He immediately changed into the King and retreated. He came to this temporary secondary dimension where the Throne was buried and instantly escaped the siege.

"With the secondary dimensions as a buffer, it's safer this way."

Han Xiao patted his chest, shaking off the bloodstains on his body, and changed into a new set of clothes.

Although the probability of the King being tracked by the World Tree was very low, to be on the safe side, he still used the secondary dimension as a transit zone and did not directly teleport back to the explored universe.

Immediately afterward, Han Xiao took back the throne and left behind the secondary dimension destruction device, shattering the secondary dimension and allowing it to be swallowed by the space turbulence to remove all traces.

After doing all this, Han Xiao opened the interface and took a look. The mission [The Fury of the World Tree] had been completed.

As expected, the bigger the commotion he caused, the higher the mission rating would be. At this time, he had already reached the highest rating, and the reward was quite generous. Just the EXP alone was 7,400,000,000, which was more than the EXP he had obtained from defeating the three Universal Civilizations. He had replenished a large amount of EXP and was closer to the level 360 Promotion.

The other reward notifications also popped up.

You have received Random Reward x5, Milestone Talent – [World Tree Nemesis].

[World Tree Nemesis]: When you fight an opponent from the World Tree Faction, + 12% actual damage dealt to the opponent, and there is a certain chance of triggering the [Fear] status.

You have received 5 God's Trait Transformation Points.

You have received 1 Universe Legendary Point.

"This is great." Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

There was no need to mention [World Tree Nemesis]. It was a talent that targeted the faction, and it was similar to [Elderly Killer]. Although the effect was simple, it was quite practical.

The five God's Trait Transformation Points were exactly what he needed, which was equivalent to creating five Universal Treasures. Currently, his Void God's Trait Transformation had reached the thirteenth level, and he was only two points away from leveling up. This windfall was enough to raise his Void God's Trait Transformation to the fourteenth level, and there was still some left. He was not far from reaching the fifteenth level, which reduced his workload.

The last Universe Legendary Point had clearly left a deep impression on the World Tree Civilization, and they were filled with fear of him. The next time they met, the people of the World Tree Civilization should be able to recognize him at a glance.

There was also one last reward notification on the interface. Han Xiao took a look and saw that it was a Sanctum Fragment, which meant that his authority in each Sanctum had increased by one level. This was the additional reward for the highest mission rating.

"Yo, good stuff!"

Han Xiao was stunned for a moment before he was pleasantly surprised.

The authority of the Sanctum was something he urgently needed at the moment. The higher the authority, the closer the time flow of the Sanctum would be to the main universe. Being able to level up from the mission was a pleasant surprise.

Suppressing his joy, Han Xiao left with his full harvest.

To be safe, he planned to wander in the deeper secondary dimensions for a while before returning to the explored universe.

…

At the same time, in the territory of the World Tree Civilization, the battlefield of the siege.

The battlefield was a mess, and the wreckage of the World Tree fleet was everywhere. Roots were sweeping the battlefield, swallowing all the debris.

In the command room of a main ship not far away, many World Tree experts who participated in the siege surrounded the Subduing Tree King. Their expressions were solemn, and there was still a hint of shock that had yet to fade. Some of them were injured.

Tedrian pressed on the table, his tone shocked.

"There's no doubt about the combat strength of this outsider. He's one of the strongest individuals we've seen in our many years of fighting in the universe. It's unbelievable that so many of us couldn't kill him even after attacking together … We can basically conclude that none of us are his match in a one-on-one battle. Even His Excellency Tree King will find it difficult to gain the upper hand."

Many World Tree experts felt a lingering fear, and many peak Beyond Grade As were silent.

Even the expressionless Subduing Tree King did not refute and only shook his head.

Facing the siege of more than a hundred people, this outsider actually dared to stay behind and fight head-on. They were already very shocked, but they did not expect him to still have the strength to retaliate and injure many of them.

Although they had the absolute upper hand in the siege just now, this outsider was unbelievably tough. He endured the concentrated fire of hundreds of people and did not fall. He held on for more than ten minutes before he used a strange teleportation method to escape unscathed.

Although the enemy had been expelled, the strong performance of the outsider had been deeply imprinted in everyone's hearts, almost becoming a psychological shadow. Every time they thought about it, many people could not help but feel shocked.

"Although we've chased this outsider away this time, we can't guarantee that he'll come again in the future.

This is very troublesome, "Roxilian said with a deep voice.

Tedrian nodded, his tone solemn.

"If we can't restrict the other party's special teleportation method, our territory will almost become the other party's backyard. He can come and go as he pleases, causing us to be in a passive position … We can't clear the Star Field every time and mobilize so many people to chase after him."

As he spoke, his expression became more and more surprised as he said in a serious voice,

"Furthermore, only civilizations with extremely developed individual strength can give birth to Supers of this level. Who knows how many high-level combatants of the same level there are in this outsider's civilization? We've leaked too many secrets this time. If the other party sends more Supers of the same level over next time, we'll be in trouble. "

Hearing this, everyone felt a chill in their hearts and was worried.

Han Xiao's astonishing combat strength made them make the wrong judgment. They thought that there were more experts of the same level in the explored universe, and they could not help but tremble in fear.

They had always been conquerors, and they were basically the ones who took the initiative to invade. However, at this moment, they felt a rare sense of fear and even had the thought of running away.

"Then what do you think?" another executive asked.

Tedrian gritted his teeth and said, "This alien civilization has already discovered our coordinates.

My suggestion is to clear all the Star Fields and move our base camp immediately. Only then can we avoid being harassed by the other party. Then, we can think of a way to investigate the other party's background. "

"This is indeed a way, but we can't use our advantage …" Someone objected. "If we stay here and let the enemy continue to harass us, the information entanglement will deepen. This way, we can locate the location of this unknown civilization faster."

Without waiting for Tedrian to speak, another person beside him interjected.

"I don't think so. This outsider used some methods to bewitch Barbani. The secrets of these abilities are all known by the other party. They will definitely avoid more information entanglement and won't fall for it."

Hearing this, everyone looked helpless. The biggest problem now was not that the outsiders were strong, but that the gap in intelligence was too big. They had leaked too many secrets, but they knew almost nothing about the outsiders.

The group was divided into two factions. One side suggested moving, while the other suggested staying.

"Your Excellency Tree King, what do you think?"

Tedrian turned around.

Everyone stopped discussing. In the end, it was still up to the Tree King to make the decision.

The Subduing Tree King closed his eyes and pondered for a while before opening them again.

"There's no need to move. The loss of territory is not important. The information entanglement is more important. Now that we have a certain level of interaction, I will speed up the World Tree's sensing speed. At the same time, inform the Future Form Information Perceiver team to increase the frequency of the prophecies. Then, let the expedition teams sent out in the past few years speed up their journey …"

As he spoke, the Subduing Tree King paused and slowly said,

"Also, strengthen the internal surveillance and set up more detection devices. The outsiders have already obtained some of our confidential information, so we can't just rely on the Information Form warning network … If you find another outsider, inform me immediately."

Under the Subduing Tree King's calm expression, his heart was actually surging. Han Xiao's combat strength had also surprised him, but he did not show it on his face.

Although he did not express it, the Subduing Tree King had already remembered Han Xiao deeply in his heart and was looking forward to fighting him again.

On one hand, it was the battle intent that Pugilists had. On the other hand, the World Tree had expressed its desire for Han Xiao …

Facing all new things, the mother tree had an extremely strong appetite. It requested the Subduing Tree King to send this outsider into its mouth and eat him as a tribute.

As one of the penetrators of the will of the World Tree, the Tree King's request was his mission. He could not refuse.
